e.title: **一个**用 **OData 协议**的法例登记处**：**每条法例**自带**「**现在还有效吗**」字段****：`api.prod.legislation.gov.au/v1/titles`——**⭐ 本次实测**返回体逐字含 **`"@odata.context"`**（**⭐ 即**它**不是**普通 **REST，**而**是 **OData**）**；**⭐ 每条记录**逐字含 **`isInForce`** 与 **`isPrincipal`**、**`collection`、**`subCollection`、**`makingDate`**；**⭐ 以**名称含 **Insurance** 检索**，**逐字取到**「**Health Insurance (prudential standard) determination No. 7 of 2023**」与**「**Export Finance and Insurance Corporation Amendment Act 1997**」**；**⚠️ 而**本次**两次请求**都返回 **510 条**（**`pageSize=5` 似乎**未被采纳**）**
e.title_en: A legislation register that speaks the OData protocol, where every record carries a field answering whether it is currently in force: the response names an OData context rather than being plain REST, each record carries in-force and principal flags together with a collection and sub-collection and a making date, and a search for records whose name contains the word insurance returns a health insurance prudential standard determination and an export finance and insurance corporation amendment act.

e.summary: **Federal Register of Legislation API**（澳大利亚联邦法例登记处的接口，`api.prod.legislation.gov.au/v1`）**是一个**把**联邦法例**做成**可查询数据**的接口****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**不**带密钥**即可调用**（**返回 **200**）**，**而**其**返回体逐字以 **`"@odata.context"`** 开头**（**⭐ 即**它**用的是 **OData 协议**，**查询用 **`$filter`** 这类**方言**）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**法规文本的可编程接口**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **⭐ 每条记录**自带 **`isInForce`（**现在**是否有效）**与 **`isPrincipal`（**是否**主法）**——**⭐ 即**「**这条法例**当下**还有效吗**」**是**一个**字段**，**而**不是**要读者**自己去**推断的问题**；**② **⭐ 分类字段**分成 **`collection` 与 **`subCollection` 两级****（**本次逐字见到 **`LegislativeInstrument`／**`Regulations`、**`LegislativeInstrument`／**`Rules` 与 **`Act`**）**；**⭐ 另有 **`makingDate`（**制定日）**与 **`id`（**如 **`C2004A05163`、**`F2023L00689`**）**；**③ **⭐ 以**名称含 **Insurance** 为条件检索**，**本次逐字取到**六条**，**其中**「**Health Insurance (prudential standard) determination No. 7 of 2023**」**是**健康险**审慎标准**裁定**，**「**Export Finance and Insurance Corporation Amendment Act 1997**」**是**出口融资保险**公司法**——**⭐ 即**从**登记处**里**可以**按名称**直接**找到**保险相关的**法例与**裁定**；**④ **⚠️ 两处**须如实标注**：**① **本次两次请求**都返回 **510 条****（**即便**参数写了 **`pageSize=5`**）**——**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实指出**：**该参数**本次**似乎**未被采纳**；**② **以 **`q=insurance` **检索时**，**结果里**出现**大量**与保险**无关的**「**Tariff Concession Order**」**——**⭐ 即**该 **`q` **参数的口径**较宽**，**不能**当作**精确匹配**。**⚠️ 本次**未下载任何法例全文**。
e.summary_hk: **Federal Register of Legislation API**（澳洲聯邦法例登記處的介面）**是一個**把**聯邦法例**做成**可查詢數據**的介面****——**⭐ 本次實測**：**不帶密鑰即可調用**（**返回 200**）**，**而**其返回體逐字以 `"@odata.context"` 開頭**（**⭐ 即**它用的是 OData 協議**，**查詢用 `$filter` 這類方言**）**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**法規文本的可編程介面**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **⭐ 每條記錄自帶 `isInForce`（**現在是否有效）與 `isPrincipal`（**是否主法）**——**⭐ 即**「**這條法例當下還有効嗎**」**是一個欄位**；**② **⭐ 分類欄位分成 `collection` 與 `subCollection` 兩級**（**逐字見到 LegislativeInstrument／Regulations、**LegislativeInstrument／Rules 與 Act**）**；**③ **⭐ 以名稱含 Insurance 檢索**，**逐字取到六條**，**其中 Health Insurance (prudential standard) determination No. 7 of 2023 是健康險審慎標準裁定**，**Export Finance and Insurance Corporation Amendment Act 1997 是出口融資保險公司法**；**④ **⚠️ 兩處須如實標註**：**本次兩次請求都返回 510 條（**即便寫了 `pageSize=5`**）**——**該參數本次似乎未被採納**；**以 `q=insurance` 檢索時結果裡出現大量無關的 Tariff Concession Order**——**⭐ 該 `q` 參數口徑較寬**，**不能當精確匹配**。**⚠️ 本次**未下載任何法例全文**。
e.summary_en: This interface **makes Commonwealth legislation in one jurisdiction queryable as data**, and was measured this round as callable without a key, returning a body that opens with an OData context rather than plain REST, so queries use filter expressions in that dialect. **This entry belongs to the round theme of programmable interfaces to legal text.** **Four things are worth reading: every record carries a field stating whether it is currently in force alongside a flag for whether it is principal legislation, so the question of whether a given instrument still applies is a field rather than something a reader must infer; the classification comes in two levels, a collection and a sub-collection, and this round saw legislative instruments under regulations and under rules as well as acts, together with a making date and an identifier of two different shapes; a search for names containing the word insurance returned six records, among them a health insurance prudential standard determination and an export finance and insurance corporation amendment act, so insurance instruments can be found directly by name; and two points must be stated plainly, namely that both requests this round returned five hundred and ten records even though a page size of five was given, which suggests the parameter was not honoured in this call, and that a free-text query on the word insurance returned many unrelated tariff concession orders, so that parameter is broad rather than an exact match.** **No full text was downloaded this round.**
e.body:
**Federal Register of Legislation API**（澳大利亚联邦法例登记处的接口，`api.prod.legislation.gov.au/v1`）**是一个**把**联邦法例**做成**可查询数据**的接口****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**不**带密钥、**不**需登录**即可调用**（**返回 **200**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**法规文本的可编程接口**」**。

**可核实信息（均本次只读调用实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 每条记录自带「**现在是否有效**」字段****——**⭐ 本次实测**其返回体逐字以 **`"@odata.context":"https://api.prod.legislation.gov.au/v1/$metadata#Titles"`** 开头**，**`value` 数组里**每条记录**逐字含 **`id`、**`name`、**`makingDate`、**`collection`、**`subCollection`、**`isPrincipal`** 与 **`isInForce`****；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是本条最有价值的地方**：**⭐ 即**在**法例数据**里**，「**这条**当下**还有效吗**」**通常**要**读者**自己**判断**，**而**这里**它是**一个**布尔字段**（**本次逐字见到 **`isInForce: true`** 与 **`isInForce: false`** 两种值**）**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**合规检索**时**，**「**有效性**」**应当**是**一个**可过滤条件**，**而**不是**上下文猜测**。**⭐⭐ ② 分类分成**两级，**并**另有**制定日与**标识****——**⭐ 本次实测**逐字见到**的分类含 **`collection: "LegislativeInstrument"` 配 **`subCollection: "Regulations"`**、**`LegislativeInstrument` 配 **`Rules`**，**以及 **`collection: "Act"`****；**⭐ 标识**有两种形状**（**逐字如 **`C1913L00243`、**`C2004A05163` 与 **`F2023L00689`、**`F2018L00627`**）**，**并**逐字带 **`makingDate`**（**⭐ 本次见到的值**如 **`1913-09-10T00:00:00`**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**「**法律**」与**「**立法性文件／**规则**」**在**数据模型里**是**不同层级**，**而**这**直接影响**它们**是否**可以被**单独引用**。**⭐⭐ ③ 可以按名称**直接找到**保险相关的法例与裁定****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**以 **`$filter=contains(name,’Insurance’) and isInForce eq true` **查询**，**逐字取到**六条**，**其中**「**Health Insurance (prudential standard) determination No. 7 of 2023**」（**`F2023L00689`，**制定日 **2023-05-24**）**是**健康险**审慎标准**裁定**；**「**Export Finance and Insurance Corporation Amendment Act 1997**」（**`C2004A05163`**，**集合逐字为 **`Act`**）**是**出口融资保险**公司法**；**其余**逐字含**两条**名称以 **National Disability Insurance Scheme** 开头的文件（**⭐ 其名称**在**接口返回中**已被截断，**本词条**故不引其全名**；**残障保险**计划，**逐字含 **`Rules` 子类**）**、**「**Health Insurance (Medicare Participation Review Committee) Guidelines**」与**一条**以**「**Banking, Insurance, Life Insurance, Health Insurance and Superannuation**」**开头的文件**（**⭐ 后者名称**在**返回中**亦被截断**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 RIAA 有用**：**⭐ 即**从**登记处**里**可以**按名称**把**「**保险**」相关的**法例、**审慎标准**与**计划规则**一并**筛出来**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 两处**须如实标注****——**⭐ ① **本次两次请求**都返回 **510 条**，**即便**参数里**写了 **`pageSize=5`****——**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实指出**：**该**分页参数**本次**似乎**未被采纳**（**⭐ 本词条**不推测**其**默认分页**规则**）**；**⭐ ② **以 **`q=insurance` 检索**时**，**首页结果**里**出现**大量**与**保险**无关的 **`Tariff Concession Order`**（**关税减让令**）**——**⭐ 即**该**自由文本参数**口径较宽**，**不能**当作**精确匹配**（**⭐ 故**本条**在描述结果时**改用**名称条件**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[data-gov-au]] 覆盖**澳大利亚政府数据接口**、**[[us-federal-register-api]] 与**[[uk-legislation-api]] 覆盖**美英两国的**法规接口**、**[[ans-tiss-standard]] 与**[[risk-data-library-standard]] 覆盖**标准文本**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**用 **OData 协议**、**并**把**有效性**做成**字段**的**法例登记处接口**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **有效性**要**做成**字段**（**可过滤**）**，**而**不是**留给**读者推断**；**② **层级**（**法／**规则）**要**在**数据模型里**分开**；**③ **分页参数**要**在**文档里**写清**（**⭐ 本条**如实记录了**参数未被采纳**这一现象**）**；**④ **自由文本检索**与**名称检索**要**分开看待**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载**任何法例的**全文**（**未取任何正文、**未核对任何条文**）**，**故**不主张**其**内容**、**不主张**其**修订状态**、**也**不主张**其 **`isInForce` 字段**在**任何具体日期**的**正确性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**该接口返回的**列表数据**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**查询语言**（**OData）**的**完整能力**（**⭐ 本次**只用到了 **`$filter` 的一种写法**与 **`q`**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**使用条款与**频率限制**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**本文中**取到的**保险相关法例**的**具体内容**（**⭐ 本条**只记录**名称、**标识、**类型与**制定日**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该接口**返回的是**澳大利亚联邦层面**的登记信息**，**不构成**法律意见**。
e.body_hk:
**Federal Register of Legislation API**（澳洲聯邦法例登記處的介面，`api.prod.legislation.gov.au/v1`）**是一個**把**聯邦法例**做成**可查詢數據**的介面****——**⭐ 本次實測**：**不帶密鑰、**不需登錄即可調用**（**返回 200**）**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**法規文本的可編程介面**」**。

**可核實資訊（均本次只讀調用實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 每條記錄自帶「**現在是否有效**」欄位****——**返回體逐字以 `"@odata.context":"https://api.prod.legislation.gov.au/v1/$metadata#Titles"` 開頭**，**`value` 陣列裡每條記錄逐字含 `id`、`name`、`makingDate`、`collection`、`subCollection`、`isPrincipal` 與 `isInForce`****——**⭐ 即在法例數據裡**，「**這條當下還有効嗎**」**通常要讀者自己判斷**，**而這裡它是**一個布林欄位**（**本次見到 `isInForce: true` 與 `false` 兩種值**）**——**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**合規檢索時**，「**有效性**」**應是可過濾條件**。**⭐⭐ ② 分類分成兩級，**並另有制定日與標識****——**逐字見到 LegislativeInstrument／Regulations、**LegislativeInstrument／Rules 與 Act**；**標識有兩種形狀**（**`C1913L00243`、**`C2004A05163` 與 `F2023L00689`、**`F2018L00627`**）**，**並逐字帶 `makingDate`**（**如 `1913-09-10T00:00:00`**）**——**⭐ 即**「**法律**」與「**立法性文件／**規則**」在數據模型裡是不同層級**。**⭐⭐ ③ 可按名稱直接找到保險相關的法例與裁定****——**以 `$filter=contains(name,’Insurance’) and isInForce eq true` 查詢**（**⭐ 引號約定**：**該查詢原文用 **ASCII 單引號**，**本站按既有約定寫作 **U+2019**，**故**此處所引**與**原文**在**引號字元上**並不位元組相同**）**，**逐字取到六條**：**Health Insurance (prudential standard) determination No. 7 of 2023（**`F2023L00689`，**2023-05-24**）、**Export Finance and Insurance Corporation Amendment Act 1997（**`C2004A05163`，**Act**）、**兩條 National Disability Insurance Scheme（**Rules 子類**）、**Health Insurance (Medicare Participation Review Committee) Guidelines 與一條含 Banking, Insurance, Life Insurance, Health Insurance and Superannuation 的文件****。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 兩處須如實標註****——**① 本次兩次請求都返回 510 條（**即便寫了 `pageSize=5`**）**——**該分頁參數本次似乎未被採納**；**② 以 `q=insurance` 檢索時首頁出現大量無關的 Tariff Concession Order**——**⭐ 該自由文本參數口徑較寬**，**不能當精確匹配**，**故本條改用名稱條件描述結果**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[data-gov-au]]、[[us-federal-register-api]]、[[uk-legislation-api]]、[[ans-tiss-standard]]、[[risk-data-library-standard]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**用 OData 協議、**並把有效性做成欄位的法例登記處介面**」這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **有效性做成可過濾欄位**；**② **層級要在數據模型裡分開**；**③ **分頁參數要在文檔裡寫清**；**④ **自由文本檢索與名稱檢索分開看待**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有下載任何法例的全文**，**不主張**其內容**、**修訂狀態**，**也不主張**其 `isInForce` 欄位在任何具體日期的正確性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀該介面返回的列表數據**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其查詢語言（**OData）的完整能力**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其使用條款與頻率限制**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**本文中取到的保險相關法例的具體內容**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該介面返回澳洲聯邦層面的登記資訊**，**不構成法律意見**。
e.body_en:
This interface **makes Commonwealth legislation in one jurisdiction queryable as data**, measured this round as callable without a key and without signing in. **This entry belongs to the round theme of programmable interfaces to legal text.**

**Verified information, all from read-only calls made this round**: **first, every record carries a field stating whether it is currently in force.** The response opens with an OData context naming the metadata document and a titles entity set, and each record inside it carries an identifier, a name, a making date, a collection, a sub-collection, a principal flag and an in-force flag, both true and false values appearing. **In legislation data the question of whether an instrument still applies usually has to be inferred by the reader, whereas here it is a boolean field, and for compliance searching validity should be a filterable condition rather than context.** **Second, the classification has two levels and there are separate making dates and identifiers.** The values seen include legislative instruments under regulations and under rules, and acts as a separate collection, with identifiers of two shapes, one letter-prefixed and year-based for acts and another for instruments, always accompanied by a making date. **That matters because a statute and a legislative instrument sit at different levels in the data model, which affects whether each can be cited on its own.** **Third, insurance instruments can be found directly by name.** A filter for records whose name contains the word insurance and which are in force returned six items, among them a health insurance prudential standard determination made in May 2023 and an export finance and insurance corporation amendment act in the acts collection, alongside two disability insurance scheme instruments, health insurance participation review guidelines, and one instrument whose name lists banking, insurance, life insurance, health insurance and superannuation together. **For this project that means the register can be filtered by name to bring insurance statutes, prudential standards and scheme rules into one list.** **Fourth, two points must be stated plainly**: both requests returned five hundred and ten records even though a page size of five was given, so **this entry records that the paging parameter appeared not to be honoured in these calls without speculating about the default rule**; and a free-text query on the word insurance returned many unrelated tariff concession orders, **so that parameter is broad rather than exact, which is why the results above were described using a name condition instead.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover an Australian government data interface and the North American and British legal interfaces collected alongside this one, plus standard documents, **while this entry supplies a legislation register that speaks the OData protocol and exposes validity as a field. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: make validity a filterable field rather than something a reader infers; separate levels such as statutes and rules in the data model; document paging behaviour clearly, as this entry records a parameter that was not honoured; and treat free-text search and name search as different tools.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no full text of any instrument was downloaded**, no body was retrieved and no provision was checked, **so no claim is made about its contents, its amendment status, or the correctness of its in-force field on any particular date**. **Second, only the list data returned by the interface was read.** **Third, the full capability of its query language was not verified**, only one filter expression and one free-text query being used here. **Fourth, its terms of use and rate limits were not verified.
